question: Does preserving ordered signed waveform information improve imagined-word decoding beyond matched peripheral/timing information and same-trial spectral EEG?

acquisition.source_headers: All ten pinned object versions, sizes and ETags checked before body acquisition; copy opaque BDF bytes and technical headers only.

inheritance: All scientific fields of the original temporal-versus-spectral plan are retained. Only the explicit ancillary event placement and fresh execution identities change as detailed below. No new acquisition is authorized; reuse the complete committed session-two acquisition.

decoder_gate.scope: All ten ses-02 files; hashes, headers and Status only. Require exact ordered agreement between frozen and independent source-compatible decoders and all thirty split preflights before physiology.
decoder_gate.session_rules: No session-1 sub-10 short-pulse filter or missing-baseline allowance; no session-1 sub-03 condition correction. Require baseline-end for everyone and condition layout 21,22,22,23,23 for five runs.

eligibility.rule: Keep only uniquely identified original slots with observed cue, action and relax. At most one missing phase per otherwise valid slot. Never infer labels/timestamps, compress original indices, drop a person/condition or change the decoder after inspection. Structural exclusion is not proven missing-at-random.

features.EEG_temporal: 128 EEG channels, EEG-only common-average reference, per-window channel demean, 32 ordered signed bin means per channel; no new filter or learned spatial transform.
features.windows: Action: final2048 samples ending at observed relax. Cue: first384 samples after observed cue. Late: final384 samples of action. All within observed boundaries.
features.P_exact_order: 77 original peripheral spectral/variance features; 11 original observed timing/availability features; 352 temporal features (32 signed bin means for each of the same11 EXG-derived channels).
features.comparability: Every joint, deranged, label-null and spectral-joint arm shares identical P440. EEG and peripheral blocks use training-only scaling and sqrt(block width) normalization. Spectral comparator uses identical fresh trials, splits and P, not session-1 scores.

estimator.null_training: All three learned label-null arms use the same fixed outer-training label permutation throughout inner fitting and calibration. No validation labels influence features, scaling, regularization or temperature.

cue_sensitivity.population: All ten inner-condition cue EEG-only pairs
cue_sensitivity.interpretation: Sensitivity to a recorded cue response is not imagined-word information or cortical attribution. Failure does not prove absence of biological signal.

progression: Primary AND cue sensitivity must pass to propose later untouched confirmation. No outcome automatically authorizes session-3 access. Action EEG-only, other conditions, calibration and every null remain reported regardless of primary.

interpretation: Prospectively specified development comparison on structurally eligible same-day within-person four-word session-two trials, after source event structure was audited but before any session-two physiological feature extraction or scoring. Not independent confirmation of the earlier work; not cortical origin, cue-independent thoughts, arbitrary text, new-day robustness, unseen-person generalization, prospective live use or clinical utility. The fixed ordered signed bin means are not beta-envelope trajectories. No architecture ceiling is established by failure of this one representation.

ancillary_correction.default: False; session-one and original temporal entrypoints retain the original refusal.
